newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt seeks up to 50,000 T soybeans -trade.
newsitem.headline: Egypt seeks up to 50,000 T soybeans -trade.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company has invited bids for up to 50,000 tonnes of soybeans for loading by December 20 and delivery by January 15, traders based in Cairo said on Thursday.

The company has asked traders to send separate bids, one for 30,000 tonnes and one for 50,000 tonnes, both as single cargoes, one trader said. The trader said he expected it would select only one cargo. The soybean could be any origin, he added.
Another trader said the company had asked for 50,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean, No. 2 or better.
Food Industries Company was not available to clarify the discrepancy.
